records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2021
records.text: •SaaS and license revenue increased 18% to $113.2 million in the three months ended June 30, 2021 from $95.7 million in the three months ended June 30, 2020.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2021
records.text: SaaS and license revenue represented 60% and 61% of our revenue during the three and six months ended June 30, 2021, respectively, as compared to 68% and 64% in the same periods in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2021
records.text: Software license revenue represented 4% and 5% of our revenue during the three and six months ended June 30, 2021, respectively, as compared to 7% for the same periods in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2021
records.text: While the additional import duties have resulted in an increase to our cost of hardware revenue, these import duties had a modest impact on hardware revenue margins.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2021
records.text: For the six months ended June 30, 2021, cash flows from operating activities were $45.3 million, compared to $48.0 million for the same period in the prior year.
